evidence.reason: `discard()` still writes the cleanup warning directly to stderr at line 586. `download()` calls `discard(part)` from its exception path before re-raising, so a failed download with an unlink failure emits this warning before `main()` can produce the machine-mode JSON error. That violates the current I1 machine-mode requirement that `--json` leaves stderr empty; the diagnostic should be carried on the primary exception/result instead of printed directly.
